post.description: Existing operation wrapped by requestArtistResearch. Rebuild stored Lore and check social posts under existing ownership/cooldown rules. No arbitrary website/PDF refresh, no synchronous scraping, no completed-job promise. Call research/status separately. Keep this operation in research.json when integrating with the docs engine.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Artist ID in this deployment environment. Authorize claimant/admin on each call.

privyBearer.description: Existing authenticated Music Nerd user, approved artist claimant or admin. Credentials remain outside model arguments.

Coverage.description: Coverage of stored eligible records, not a claim that all external material or PDF pages were extracted. For non-search reads, searchedSources is zero. Legacy extraction limits must be explicit.

revision.description: Includes empty stored evidence, so unreadable/unknown sources remain identifiable without claiming readable content.

publishedAt.description: Preserve available precision; do not invent a time for a date-only publication.

Passage.description: Exact original-text window. Offsets are half-open UTF-16 code units into the requested evidence revision; surrogate pairs are not split. Page/audio locations are null without a verified extraction map. end-start equals text.length in JavaScript.

Brief.description: Stored profile and bounded generated orientation only. No synthesis or refresh. Load history/corrections before drafting. A generated summary is never independent cited evidence.

Search.description: Top ranked matches, not an exhaustive archive. Empty matches with accurate coverage is a success. Search may be incomplete only with explicit limitations. Expand a hit by source ID/revision; do not claim no relevant history from no matches.

SourceRead.description: Requested window from the pinned revision. nextStart continues the same revision; null means exhausted. Legacy empty/unreadable extraction is a successful empty window with unknown/failed extraction state where known, not proof of complete extraction.

fields.description: Verbatim field slices. Normal answers include question and answer; corrections include claim and correction. Continuation may contain one field only. Null answer remains explicit. All field text counts toward the total character budget. The cursor resumes the same entry revision and unfinished field before the next entry.

HistoryEntry.description: Exact question/answer or claim/correction field slices with explicit continuation for long fields. Do not infer skipped versus offered status from null alone. Never summarize or silently truncate the artist’s text.

History.description: constraintsComplete is true only after all current corrections in the requested traversal have been returned, including continuations. A client must also carry current unsaved instructions/answers independently. Never reconstruct offer time from answer-update time.

extractionOutcomes.description: Present for source_extract. Attempt results; completion does not imply readable or editorially verified evidence.

Job.description: Sanitized progress only. Do not return raw state, last_error, run/dataset credentials, provider payloads or SQL. A job being done does not establish evidence completeness.

Refresh.description: Existing response. May describe cooldown, ongoing work or inability to start; not a receipt promising a new job or complete source refetch.
